commit.subject: LU-19825 lustre: Use io_wait_event() instead of wait_event()
commit.message:
LU-19825 lustre: Use io_wait_event() instead of wait_event()

For case which are I/O related, we should use io_wait_event() instead
of wait_event().

This allows the kernel to account sleeping processes waiting for IO rather than waiting for the task to be runnable. That helps with vmstat, top and other commands that distinguish how processes are sleeping.


Signed-off-by: Nikos Papakonstantinou <npapakonstantinou@ddn.com>
Change-Id: Ic84cd67af69c1bb3a118f664a8bc52a8532bd130
